title: VUA EAC termination allowlist v0.1
description: The termination allowlist data face (proposal 006 R2, accepted by user ruling U1). The list starts EMPTY and stays empty until real-machine verification evidence produces the first qualified entry (R2: entries come only from real-machine evidence — no self-attestation loop). Every entry carries the four required elements (R2): process name, expected path pattern, signature/publisher evidence, and the reason it was listed; plus the real-machine evidence reference and the release-notes marker requirement (R8: every list change goes into the release notes). Path patterns are prefix-or-literal matched case-insensitively; anything the loader cannot fully validate is a load error, never a weakened entry.

expectedPathPattern.description: Case-insensitive prefix-or-literal pattern for the executable path (e.g. C:\Program Files (x86)\EasyAntiCheat\).

publisherEvidence.description: The signature/publisher evidence recorded when the entry was created (signer name and certificate subject as verified on the real machine).

reason.description: Why this process is safe to terminate as a VUA-managed step (R2 element 4).

evidenceRef.description: Reference to the real-machine verification evidence that produced this entry (R2: entries come only from real-machine evidence).

releaseNotes.description: The release-notes entry that announced this change (R8: every list change goes into the release notes).
